title: Pause-menu Audio toggle silences ALL audio permanently — mute and volume share one localStorage key
summary: User report: 'voice synth doesn't work, I don't hear anything'. Reproduced live. Root cause is NOT in the voice path — S145 wiring and S148 AudioContext-resume are both correct. The actual cause is `examples/kaboom-crew/src/audio-fx.ts:232` — `let muted = masterGain === 0;`. Bootstrap reads the masterGain dial from `localStorage["agf.audio.volume"]` via `resolveAudioVolume()`. The pause-menu 'Audio: ON/OFF' button writes to the SAME localStorage key (`bootstrap.ts:852`: `storage?.setItem("agf.audio.volume", next ? "0" : "1")`). Result: one click on 'Audio: OFF' saves `"0"`, and on every subsequent page load the audioFx initializes with `masterGain=0` AND `muted=true`. Subsequent unmute via the pause menu sets `muted=false` but does NOT restore masterGain — every play() that DOES run routes through gain nodes scaled by `masterGain * (per-event factor)` = 0, so the world stays silent. The Voice synth was the visible victim (S145, S148, the testVoice helper all looked broken from user POV) but bombs, footsteps, blasts, pickups are all equally silent. Tested S109 / S110 voice work end-to-end once the localStorage key is cleared.
repro: Open `?project=kaboom-crew` in a fresh browser tab (no localStorage for the site yet). All audio works.
Press Esc to open the pause menu. Click 'Audio: ON' once → label flips to 'Audio: OFF'. Audio stops as expected.
Open DevTools → Application → Local Storage → confirm `agf.audio.volume = "0"` is now persisted.
Click 'Audio: OFF' again to toggle back → label flips to 'Audio: ON'. **Audio is still silent** (already a bug here, but the worse case is below).
Reload the page. Press SPACE to start the game. Place a bomb, walk on a pickup, watch the bot die — no audio at all, including the procedural voice.
From DevTools console: `__agf.kaboom.testVoice('pickup')` returns `false` (muted=true). The voice events from gameplay never even reach the synth.
Workaround (confirms root cause): `localStorage.removeItem('agf.audio.volume'); location.reload();` — audio restored, voice plays normally.
expected: Toggling 'Audio: OFF' silences audio for the current session but should NOT permanently disable audio on reload. EITHER (a) the mute toggle and the volume dial use distinct localStorage keys (e.g. `agf.audio.muted` + `agf.audio.volume`), OR (b) toggling 'Audio: ON' from a previously-muted state restores masterGain to its non-zero default (or the last non-zero saved value), so the audio path comes back to life without a localStorage purge.
actual: One click on 'Audio: OFF' permanently muddles the two states. On reload, `masterGain` initializes to 0 from `dial=0`, `muted` initializes to `true` from `masterGain === 0`, and clicking 'Audio: ON' in the pause menu only flips `muted=false` — `masterGain` stays 0, every play() routes through a 0-gain envelope, world stays silent. From the user's POV: 'I clicked one menu button last week, now audio doesn't work and nothing I do brings it back.' The recent S145 / S148 voice fixes are unaffected — the bug is upstream of the voice path.
